The most important rule:

Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says "remote."

Reject the job if it requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan.

Reject the job if it requires local work authorization outside Taiwan.

Reject the job if it is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only.

Reject the job if it requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan.

Keep the job only if one of these is true:

The job says worldwide remote.

The job says work from anywhere.

The job says global remote.

The job says APAC remote.

The job allows international contractors.

The job accepts people based anywhere.

The company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement.

Return JSON only:

{
"taiwan_eligible": "yes/no/unclear",
"reason": "short reason",
"location_risk": "low/medium/high",
"timezone_risk": "low/medium/high",
"contractor_possible": "yes/no/unclear",
"decision": "keep/reject/manual_check"
}`, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Job post:\n\n' + $json.description }] }) }}

parameters.content:
## Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

Rule #1: a job only survives if Jerry can do it while physically based in Taiwan — no relocation, no US/EU/UK/Canada/Australia work authorization, no fixed midnight hours.

Pipeline: fetch sources -> normalize -> keyword match -> dedupe vs Google Sheet -> hard keyword filter -> AI eligibility check (Claude) -> async filter -> role fit -> score -> route to Filtered/Rejected sheets -> digest + instant alerts + cover letter drafts for 85+ scores.

### Source notes

Enabled out of the box (public API/RSS, no auth needed): Remote OK, Remotive, We Work Remotely.

Disabled placeholders (no stable public feed as of writing): Himalayas, Wellfound, Dynamite Jobs, Y Combinator Work at a Startup, Otta. Point these at a real API/RSS endpoint or a self-hosted RSS-Bridge instance, then enable the node. Output must include job_title/company/job_url/location_text/salary/description/posted_date/tags so Normalize Jobs picks it up automatically.

### Credentials needed

- Google Sheets OAuth2 (read + append across 4 tabs)
- Telegram Bot API (daily digest + instant alerts) and/or Gmail OAuth2
- HTTP Header Auth credential named for Anthropic, header 'x-api-key' = your Claude API key (used for eligibility checks + cover letters)

Fill in the Config node: spreadsheetId, telegramChatId, digestEmailTo. Replace every 'PUT_CREDENTIAL_ID' placeholder with your real credentials.

### Google Sheet: 'Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Jobs'

Raw Jobs: date_found, source, job_title, company, job_url, location_text, salary, description, posted_date, tags, job_id

Filtered Jobs: date_found, score, job_title, company, job_url, salary, taiwan_eligible, taiwan_reason, location_risk, timezone_risk, contractor_possible, async_level, role_category, why_good_fit, decision, application_status, notes

Applied: date_applied, job_title, company, job_url, cover_letter_used, status, follow_up_date, notes (filled in manually as you apply)

Rejected: date_rejected, job_title, company, job_url, reason

Cover Letters (added beyond the original spec to hold generated drafts): date_found, job_title, company, job_url, score, cover_letter_draft
